card.text: Explore Tarqeq, a moon of Saturn, through its lightcurve-constrained shape approximation.

introduction.text: Tarqeq turns slowly, with a measured rotation period of 76.13 hours. Its light curve gives a minimum equatorial ratio of 1.32:1, while this model assumes the polar depth and orientation. The grid marks unmapped terrain.

model.title: Light-curve shape approximation
model.summary: Approximate ellipsoid adopting minimum equatorial ratio 1.32:1 under uniform reflectivity. Equal short axes and volume scaling are assumed. Orientation and phase are illustrative. The grid marks unmapped terrain.
